evidence: Matches the 'Docs' label and primarily updates Doxygen code comments across 13 files alongside enabling documentation compiler warnings.
rationale: Corrects malformed Doxygen tags such as '@peer[in]' to '@param[in]' and enables `-Wdocumentation-unknown-command` to catch future syntax errors. While primarily markup cleanup rather than correcting misleading conceptual documentation, enabling the compiler flag provides ongoing prevention against silent documentation parsing failures.
